name: legs up the wall yoga pose
description: A restful pose where your legs rest up a wall, gently stretching the backs of the legs and easing tension in the lower back.
instructions: Sit sideways next to a wall and lie back as you swing your legs up the wall.
Move your hips close to the wall, with your arms relaxed at your sides.
Keep your knees soft if the hamstrings feel tight.
Breathe slowly and relax your shoulders and jaw.
Hold for 1-5 minutes, then bend your knees and roll to one side to come up.
